neighbours.label: verbs of escalation or widening (intensified, widened, hardened, deepened, tighten)
fire: Political instability intensified as extremist groups gained ground.
The policy has widened the gap between rich and poor.
Resentment slowly hardened into open hostility.
The recession deepened over the winter months.
Citizens are being asked to tighten their belts.
Fighting escalated along the northern border.
Pressure on housing has intensified in recent years.
The dispute sharpened divisions within the party.
quiet: Political instability continued as extremist groups gained ground.
The policy has affected the gap between rich and poor.
Resentment slowly turned into open discussion.
The recession continued over the winter months.
Citizens are being asked to check their budgets.
Fighting occurred along the northern border.
Pressure on housing has existed for many years.
The dispute revealed divisions within the party.
